description: A two-player chess clock with tap-to-switch, optional increment per move, flag detection, pause and reset.

faqs.a: Tap the clock of the player who just moved. Their clock stops, the increment is added, and the opponent's clock starts.
faqs.q: How do I switch the clock?

faqs.a: Set minutes and increment, then tap either side to start — the other player's clock begins running.
Yes — when a clock reaches zero it flags: the timer stops, the side flashes red and a sound plays.
faqs.q: What happens when time runs out?

faqs.a: Fischer increment: the seconds you set are added to a player's clock every time they tap their side.

howto: Set the starting minutes and optional increment seconds.
Tap either side to start the other player's clock.
After each move, the player taps their own side to switch.
Pause or Reset anytime from the buttons below.
title: Chess Clock Timer
